title: YouTube Long-Form Video Editor (3 Videos/Week, $250/month)
description:
I am a content creator building a personal brand around identity coaching and personal development. I need a dedicated editor for my YouTube long-form videos only. I already have a separate editor for short-form content.

Volume:



3 YouTube videos per week

10-15 minutes each

Ongoing monthly work



What I provide:



Raw video files uploaded to Google Drive

Scripts with section timestamps

Brand guidelines and style references

Thumbnail text and direction



What I need from you:



Full edit with intro, section transitions, and outro

Section title lower thirds (clean, editorial, warm tones)

B-roll integration when I provide it

YouTube thumbnail design for each video (clean, editorial, large text, warm tones, my face)

Background music selection (subtle, cinematic, never distracting)

Warm color grading (golden-hour tones, not cold or blue)

Export 16:9, 1080p or 4K

Turnaround: 2-3 days per video



Style direction:



Warm, editorial, cinematic. Not flashy or over-edited.

Think sit-down conversation, not a vlog. Pacing should breathe.

Color palette: warm cream, deep brown, gold accents

Typography on screen: clean serif for titles, sans-serif for body text

No swooshes, no corporate transitions, no stock intros. Clean hard cuts with occasional subtle fades between sections.

Reference channels: Ali Abdaal's pacing, Khe Hy's warmth, but with a darker and more cinematic tone



Tools:



Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut (your choice)

Canva or Photoshop for thumbnails



Budget: $250 USD per month flat rate. Paid monthly.

Working hours: I upload raw footage in the evening US Eastern time. I need edited videos back within 2-3 days. We communicate via WhatsApp.

To apply, include:



2 examples of YouTube videos you have edited (10+ minutes, sit-down or interview format preferred)

1 example of a YouTube thumbnail you designed

Your monthly rate confirmation

Your timezone and working hours

How quickly you can start

We're looking for a skilled landing page specialist with a proven track record of building high-converting pages — ideally in GoHighLevel. You'll be creating pages that don't just look good, but actually convert, specifically for the real estate and business consulting niches.

Design and build high-converting landing pages (preferably in GoHighLevel)

Proven experience building landing pages that convert — not just designing them

A portfolio you can show us, ideally with real conversion numbers or results

Experience with split testing and optimisation, with examples of what you've learned

Confidence linking pages to ad platforms 
, Google, etc.)

Ongoing work for the right candidate.

description:
We are a small team that manages a number of Instagram accounts, and we are growing. We need a Social Media Manager who is organized, communicates well in English, and can work without being managed closely. This is a long-term remote job and there is room to take on more over time.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper (E-Commerce | Amazon Experience Required)
description:
Part-Time Bookkeeper (E-Commerce | US Pet Supply Company) - Amazon Experience Required



Contractor Role | 16–20 Hours/Month | EST Overlap Required  



About the Role  

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, e-commerce–savvy Bookkeeper to join our US-based pet supply company. This is a part-time, independent contractor role  (approx. 4 hours/week) with flexible scheduling and a required overlap with US EST business hours. You’ll be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, tracking inventory, and supporting our e-commerce operations across multiple platforms. You’ll work closely with company leadership and periodically present financial insights to C-level stakeholders.



If you’re an experienced bookkeeper who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants a long-term partnership, this could be the perfect fit.



What’s in It for You?

- Competitive pay (based on experience)

- Flexible hours with partial EST overlap

- Remote work — from the comfort of your home

- Long-term opportunity with room to grow



Be part of an exciting, people-first company in the pet supply niche!



About Us

We are a US-based e-commerce business specializing in pet supplies and dog training products.  As we grow, we’re seeking a reliable bookkeeper who understands both US accounting practices  and the unique needs of e-commerce bookkeeping, with specific focus on Amazon Seller Central.  



Responsibilities

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment processors (PayPal, Stripe, etc.)

- Perform month-end closing and prepare financial reports

- Track sales, returns, refunds, and fees across e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, etc)

- Ensure accurate recording of inventory, COGS, and related adjustments

- Support compliance with GAAP standards and tax-related documentation

- Prepare and present financial summaries and insights to C-level stakeholders as needed

- Participate in periodic meetings with company leadership to review financial performance and answer questions



Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (Required)

- 3–5 years of bookkeeping experience (supporting US-based e-commerce companies or accounting firms)

- Amazon Seller Central experience strongly required

- Knowledge of SellerBoard required

- Proficiency with QuickBooks or Xero, plus Google Workspace/Microsoft Office  

- Experience with e-commerce platforms and marketplace accounting

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial data

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and adapt in a dynamic environment

- Experience communicating and presenting financial reports or insights to senior leadership or executive teams



Requirements

- Personal computer and reliable high-speed internet

- Quiet, distraction-free workspace

- Ability to work part-time with consistent EST overlap hours



Ideal Candidate Profile

- Organized & Detail-Oriented  – You spot errors before anyone else does.

- Process-Oriented  – You create efficient workflows and stick to them.

- Client-Service Mindset  – You’re proactive, responsive, and reliable.

- Adaptable & Tech-Savvy  – You embrace new tools and learn quickly.

- Passionate Learner  – You enjoy growing your skills and staying current in e-commerce trends.

- Executive-Ready Communicator – You can confidently explain financials, trends, and recommendations to C-level leaders in a clear, professional way.



If this sounds like a good fit for you, please send a copy or link to your resume and a short cover letter highlighting your e-commerce bookkeeping experience.

title: Experienced Customer service/Inside Sales
description:
“We love to break $%*&!”



That's our motto at Big Hammer—we help customers tackle their demolition projects by providing quality tools and products. Our Shopify store is growing, and we're looking for a proactive, detail-oriented tea
mber to join our team and support our rapid expansion!



Our Shopify store is growing fast and we’re hiring an EXPERIENCED B2B Inside Sales Virtual Assistant to own inbound leads (phone +
), run quotes, follow up like a professional, and build real customer relationships.



WORKING HOURS:



• Standard US business hours

• Main shift: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

• Onboarding hours may vary slightly depending on what works best for you and us



WHAT YOU’LL DO (KEY RESPONSIBILITIES):



1. Inside Sales/Customer service (Primary)



• Answer inbound calls/emails/messages and convert inquiries into quotes/orders

• Sell in a B2B relationship world: repair shops, rental fleets, dealers, municipal purchasing—repeat customers and professional persistence

• Ask the right questions to confirm fitment (model, serial/variant info when relevant, part #, photos, measurements when needed)

• Prepare and send quotes using our templates/process

• Follow up consistently until the deal is closed or clearly dead (no dropped leads)

• Handle common B2B workflows: written quotes, purchase orders (POs), lead time questions, “send me a quote for purchasing,” etc.

• Communicate in a practical, direct, customer-friendly way (not corporate fluff)



2. CRM + Pipeline Discipline



• Keep CRM notes clean and complete (what they need, what we quoted, what’s missing, next step)

• Keep pipeline stages accurate and set follow-up tasks/reminders

• Capture lead source details when available (we care about attribution)



3. E-commerce Support (Secondary)



• Upload/update/edit product listings on Shopify (as assigned)

• Help with order processing and customer updates when needed

• Review drawings/product images for accurate part numbers/product details (accuracy matters)



4. General VA Support (As needed)



• Data entry and organization (Google Sheets/Excel; Notion if used)

• Light image edits in Canva (nice to have)

• Online research and assistant support that helps sales/ops



REQUIREMENTS (PLEASE DON’T APPLY IF YOU DON’T MEET THESE):



• 3+ years inside sales experience (required).

• Strong English (spoken + written) and confident phone presence

• Proven follow-up discipline (you can explain your cadence/system)

• CRM experience required (HubSpot preferred)

• Shopify experience

• Detail-oriented

• Strong working knowledge of AI tools (ChatGPT or similar) for example: call summaries, follow-ups, quote notes—while verifying facts

• Reliable internet, good headset, quiet workspace



BONUS POINTS:



• Experience selling technical products/parts (heavy equipment parts, industrial supplies, auto parts, machinery, hydraulics)

• Experience working with purchasing departments/PO workflows

• HubSpot power user (pipelines, tasks, sequences)

• Shopify experience (product updates + order workflow)



WHY JOIN BIG HAMMER?



• Positive team environment: We prioritize open communication, respect, and continuous support to ensure your success.

• Growth Opportunities: As we grow, you'll have the opportunity to expand your role and develop professionally. Lots of growth potential.

• Bonus program to reward performance



HOW TO APPLY (IMPORTANT):

Please use the form link below to apply.

** All applications sent through the OnlineJobs portal/messaging will be ignored. **

1. Check your task list and get the right content from our shared drive

2. Add the caption and music as told, then post the Reels and Stories to the right accounts

title: Customer Service and Admin Virtual Assistant
description:
Quality Landscape & Lawn Care is a full-service landscape company with a family atmosphere, founded over 30 years ago. We specialize in residential and commercial landscape maintenance, turf care, design/build landscape installation, and commercial snow & ice management.



We’re looking for a Customer Service & Administrative Virtual Assistant who will own the first-response experience for the company across phone,
, and text communication. This role plays a major part in protecting customer experience, supporting the sales team, and making sure no lead or client inquiry falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Inbound Call Management – Answer every inbound call possible during scheduled working hours. Maintain a live answer rate of 95% or higher when not already on another call.

2. Customer Communication Management – Own the first response experience across the company phone line,
 inbox, and text messaging center. All inquiries must receive a response the same day or by 10:00 AM the following business day if received after hours or on weekends.

3. Lead Qualification & Scheduling – Qualify landscape and commercial maintenance leads, route them correctly, schedule qualified meetings for the sales team, and provide complete notes and accurate contact information.

4. CRM & Administrative Support – Maintain accurate customer records and communication logs inside Service Autopilot and other company systems.

5. Business Support Tasks – Assist with business development support, process documentation, job costing assistance, and efficiency reporting. Social media support may be added later as the role grows.





What We're Looking For:

- Fluent English, both spoken and written

- Excellent communication and customer service skills

- Strong organizational and time management skills

- Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

- Technical proficiency and ability to learn new systems quickly

- Experience using CRM systems and administrative tools

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

- Industry experience in landscaping, lawn care, or home services is a plus





What We Offer:

- Competitive salary

- Direct US company

- Paid time off

- Free training

- Yearly salary reviews

- Long-term growth opportunities

- Family-oriented company culture

- Positive, accountable, and growth-focused work environment

- A team that values communication, reliability, professionalism, and personal growth



We're hiring for a long-term position with a knack for handling dynamic schedules, juggling multiple priorities, and staying two steps ahead. If you're not interested in a lasting role with growth opportunities and you don't have the qualifications, please do not apply.



But if this resonates with you, we look forward to application!

title: Facebook Ads Manager (Campaign Setup & Optimization) – Own FB profile required
description:
About the Role

This is a pure advertising role. You will build, launch, and optimize
 ad campaigns inside Ads Manager using your own
 profile as the authorized ad account user.



Key Responsibilities

Create campaigns from briefs: audience targeting, placements, budgets, bidding.



Upload ad creatives (images, copy, headlines) provided by the creative team.



Monitor daily spend, CTR, CPC, and ROAS; pause underperforming ad sets.



Duplicate winning ads and scale budgets gradually.



Troubleshoot ad rejections and appeal when necessary.

Own active, real-name

ments and direct messages within 2 hours during work hours.

We are a photo editing studio that works exclusively with professional wedding photographers. We edit large volumes of wedding images inside Adobe Lightroom — culling, colour grading, and quality checking — so our clients can spend less time at their desk and more time doing what they love.



This is a remote, part-time role. You will receive jobs via a shared workspace, complete your edits, and return the finished Lightroom catalog within the agreed deadline. Work volume will grow as we take on more clients.



This is recurring work.

This is not a one-off project. We are looking for editors who want ongoing, regular work.

As our client base grows, so does the number of jobs available. Reliable editors will receive more work.

We are building a long-term team — not a one-job arrangement.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Cull wedding galleries in Adobe Lightroom — selecting the best images to hit a client-specified target range

- Apply AI-generated colour grades and check every image for consistency

- QC your own work before delivery — flag any issues rather than guessing

- Communicate clearly via Google Chat when a job is ready or if there is a problem

- Follow the Selects Co Standard Operating Procedure for every job, every time



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Lightroom experience - Minimum 5 years working in Adobe Lightroom Classic

Wedding photography knowledge - Understanding of wedding day flow — ceremony, reception, portraits — so you can cull with context

Attention to detail - You care about consistency across an entire gallery, not just individual images

Reliability - You meet deadlines. If something comes up, you communicate early — not at the last minute

English communication - You can write a clear, professional message in English

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Imagen AI or similar AI editing tools

- Previous experience editing for a photography studio or business (not just personal work)

- Familiarity with wedding photography styles — film, editorial, documentary



PAY

Pay is per job, not per hour. Rate is based on image bracket size. Rates will be confirmed with you before your first live job. You will be paid reliably and on time.



Note for applicants

Before being offered a paid job, all editors complete a short paid test edit so we can check the quality of your work and how well you follow instructions.

We do not expect perfection — we expect honesty, effort, and the ability to follow a brief.



HOW TO APPLY

WHAT TO INCLUDE

title: Real Estate ISA
description:
We're hiring a full-time Inside Sales Agent (ISA) to run point on lead outreach for Savor Properties — a real estate agent in Northern Virginia.



Your job is simple: call every lead the moment they come in, follow up on a consistent cadence, and book appointments between qualified sellers and our owner, Jay.



You are not closing deals. You are opening conversations.



The best ISAs don't pitch — they listen. They ask good questions. They make the homeowner feel understood before anything else happens. Your edge is empathy and urgency, not a script you're rushing through.





What You'll Be Doing

Inbound Lead Response



Every lead that comes in gets a call. Not in 5 minutes. Not "when you get a chance." Within 10 seconds of receipt — every time. Speed to lead is the standard. This is non-negotiable.



Follow-Up Cadence



Leads that don't pick up get worked. You'll follow a structured follow-up sequence — calls, texts, voi
s — until you get a conversation or the lead is officially dead. Nothing falls through the cracks.



Cold Calling



When you're not following up with existing leads, you're dialing cold lists. Lists are provided — your job is to work through them consistently, keep your energy up, and find the people who need what we offer.



Appointment Setting



The goal of every conversation is to understand the homeowner's situation and — if they're a fit — book them for an appointment with Jay. You qualify. Jay closes.



CRM Management



Every call, every outcome, every follow-up is logged in Follow Up Boss. You keep your pipeline clean and your notes sharp. No mystery leads, no ghost activity.



Daily Sales Check-In



Every day, we review your calls and your numbers together. This isn't a performance review — it's a feedback loop. We'll listen to calls, talk through what's working, and sharpen what isn't. The best ISAs get better every single week because they're coachable and they pay attention to the data.





How to Be a Hero

Meeting the standard gets you in the door. This is how you become someone we'd never let go.



You push past the first "no." Not with pressure — with genuine curiosity. You ask one more question, you dig one level deeper, and you find out if there's actually something there. Average ISAs hang up. Great ones turn a "not interested" into a 10-minute conversation.

You bring insights to the check-in. You're not just showing up with numbers. You're showing up with observations. "I noticed leads from this list are going cold faster — here's what I think is happening." You're thinking about the pipeline, not just dialing through it.

You find patterns before we do. Best time to call, which scripts are landing, which objections keep coming up — you're tracking it without being asked. You turn your call activity into intelligence we can actually use.

You make Jay look good in every handoff. When you book an appointment, Jay walks in with context. You've qualified the lead, you've logged the situation, and Jay isn't starting from zero. The handoff is seamless because you made it that way.

You get better every week. You listen back to your own calls. You apply feedback. You don't make the same mistake twice. The ISAs who thrive here are the ones who are always improving — not the ones who think they've already figured it out.





How to Drive Me Crazy

Going quiet after a call. Log it. Every time.

Letting leads sit. Speed to lead isn't a suggestion — it's the standard.

Winging follow-up. There's a cadence. Follow it.

Burning out and going silent. This is a high-volume role. If you're struggling, say something — don't just disappear.

Needing to be reminded. You own your pipeline. I shouldn't have to check your activity to find out what's happening.





Qualifications

Proven experience in phone sales, ISA work, or high-volume outreach — real estate experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Excellent spoken English — warm, clear, and professional.

Comfortable making a high volume of calls daily without losing energy or quality.

Experience with a CRM (Follow Up Boss preferred, but any CRM works).

Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment.

Full-time availability during US business hours (Eastern Time preferred).

Self-directed — you manage your own activity without constant check-ins.





Tools You'll Use

Follow Up Boss — CRM for lead tracking and follow-up management

GoHighLevel — CRM for lead tracking and follow-up management

Slack — async communication and daily check-ins

Dialer — provided or recommended based on setup





To Apply

Fill out the application here:

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About Us



We operate a growing portfolio of Shopify ecommerce brands across several niches, including fashion, lingerie, home decor, pet products, and more.



Our products are sourced directly from 1688, and we work on building private supplier relationships to support our own fulfillment operations. We do not use CJ, DSers, AliExpress, AutoDS, or any standard dropshipping platforms.



We are looking for a true supply chain expert — someone who can guide us, improve our systems, and take ownership. This is not a role where we teach you the basics. If we hire you, you should be the most experienced person in the room when it comes to ecommerce supply chain and supplier operations.



What You’ll Do



Source winning products on 1688 by researching suppliers, comparing options, and creating shortlists



Communicate with suppliers in English regarding orders, delays, quality issues, pricing, and negotiations



Track shipments daily across all brands and flag potential delays before they become problems



Resolve stuck, delayed, lost, or returned shipments with suppliers and logistics partners



Handle fulfillment escalations by coordinating refunds, replacements, and reshipments when needed



Manage Shopify order workflows, including exports, fulfillment updates, and tracking uploads



Oversee quality control, including defect tracking, pre-shipment photos, and sample checks for new products



Negotiate better pricing, faster shipping, improved terms, and MOQs as order volume increases



Build, improve, and manage our operational SOPs — we expect to follow your lead



Provide weekly reports on order volume, fulfillment times, delays, and supplier performance



Must-Have



4+ years of hands-on ecommerce supply chain experience with 1688 sourcing and private supplier management



Experience personally managing at least $50K/month in order volume



Strong knowledge of Shopify admin, including orders, fulfillment, and tracking management



Strong written English for supplier and internal communication



Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills



Ability to manage operations across 5+ stores without losing control of details



Nice-to-Have



Mandarin language skills for dealing with non-English suppliers



Experience with international shipping to the UK, US, and EU



Experience creating SOPs or training VAs / operations assistants



Previous experience working directly for an ecommerce brand



This Role Is Not For You If



You are still new to 1688 sourcing



Your experience is mainly with CJ, DSers, AutoDS, or AliExpress automation tools



You are currently managing 10+ freelance clients and cannot give proper focus



You would need us to explain how 1688, supplier sourcing, or private fulfillment works



Why Join Us



You will own the supply chain function, not just complete small tasks



You will work directly with the founder, without unnecessary middle management



You will build the systems, write the SOPs, and shape how operations run



This is a long-term role with room for compensation growth as the brand portfolio grows



How to Apply



Send us a short message about your experience. Keep it simple and honest — we care more about what you have actually done than about a polished sales pitch.



Please include:



A quick introduction about your ecommerce supply chain background



One or two stores or brands you have worked with, even if you can only share the niche because of an NDA



Rough numbers: monthly order volume, number of suppliers managed, and number of stores handled at the same time



A short example of one 1688 supplier you recently worked with and one fulfillment issue you solved in the last few months



Anything that proves your experience, such as a screenshot, dashboard, SOP, report, or process you created



Start your message with “Portfolio SCM” so we know you read the full post.



That’s it. If we think it could be a fit, we’ll reply within 3 days.

title: AI-Driven Graphic Designer — She Reigns Creative
description:
Who we are

She Reigns Creative is a full-service digital marketing agency. We run a pod-based model serving 100+ clients across medspas, e-commerce, coaches, healthcare, and local business. We move fast and we build with AI at the center of everything. This is not a shop where designers spend three days nudging pixels in Photoshop.

The role

We're hiring a graphic designer who works with AI, not around it. You're someone who looks at a client's existing content, a competitor's winning ad, or a blank brief, and your first instinct is "I can recreate and improve this in 20 minutes using the right tools." You use Claude to think through concepts and direction, Higgsfield and Nano Banana (and similar models) to generate and iterate visuals, and your own design eye to make it actually good and on-brand.

The ideal person treats AI tools as a creative team they direct. You're constantly testing new models, finding faster paths, and building little systems so the next version is quicker than the last. If you also understand short-form video and AI video generation, that moves you to the top of the pile.

What you'll do



Recreate and adapt high-performing ad concepts. Pull a competitor's ad from the Meta Ad Library, deconstruct why it works, then rebuild it for one of our clients with their branding, products, and offer swapped in.

Take existing client content (photos, old graphics, brand assets) and reimagine it into fresh creative using AI generation tools, keeping it true to the client's brand.

Produce Meta and Google ad creative, social graphics,
 graphics, landing page visuals, and promotional assets across many client brands and styles.

Use Claude to develop concepts, write image prompts, and direct the work, then use Higgsfield, Nano Banana, GPT image tools, and others to generate and refine.

Work inside our brand systems. We have documented design systems and brand skills per client (colors, fonts, voice, templates) and you'll produce on-brand work from those.

Constantly improve your own process. Find faster tools, build reusable prompt setups, and document what works so the whole pod gets faster.



What we're looking for



Strong design fundamentals and taste. You know good composition, hierarchy, type, and color even when a machine generated the raw material. AI gets you 70% there; your eye closes the last 30%.

Genuine fluency (or fast-learner energy) with AI creative tools: Claude, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, GPT image generation, and whatever launches next month.

To Prioritize your application include the word Purple in your application.

An experimental, efficiency-obsessed mindset. You'd rather find a smarter workflow than grind manually.

Ability to match many different brand styles, not just your personal aesthetic.

Comfortable working from briefs, references, and competitor examples.

Reliable communication and the ability to work async with a US-based team.

Bonus: short-form video editing and AI video generation (Higgsfield video, runway-style tools, etc.).



Tools you'll touch

Claude, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, GPT/DALL-E image tools, Canva, Adobe (Photoshop/Illustrator helpful), Meta Ads Manager and Meta Ad Library, and our internal systems.

description:

We need someone who can take the raw project material we provide and turn it into polished, punchy, professional videos that we can use across our website, LinkedIn,
, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, TikTok and other marketing channels.



What you’ll be doing



You will create high-quality marketing videos from supplied project footage, screen recordings, renders, animations, walkthroughs, voiceovers, screenshots and other assets.



This will include:



Editing short, sharp social media videos that quickly grab attention

Excellent video editing skills

title: Content Operations Virtual Assistant (Pinterest · WordPress · Instagram · Facebook · Meta Business Suite)
description:
About this role: We are an Australian-based bridal lifestyle business operating two connected brands — an editorial bridal media platform and a luxury bridal product brand. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented VA to manage all content scheduling and publishing across both brands. Full brand details are shared after initial screening and a signed confidentiality agreement.

About the Brands

We operate two connected Australian brands in the bridal lifestyle space:



Brand 1 — An editorial bridal media platform publishing articles across five content categories. Think high-end bridal magazine in digital format. Content covers styling, planning, venues, and honeymoon destinations.

Brand 2 — A luxury Australian bridal product brand with its own Instagram,
, and Pinterest presence.

Both brands share a consistent visual aesthetic — soft, editorial, cinematic, and minimal. Everything you post must feel like it belongs to that world. Neither brand name is disclosed until after initial screening.



The Role — What You Will Do

This is a fortnightly batch role. Every two weeks you receive a complete content package containing everything pre-made and pre-written — article drafts, images, pin graphics, captions, and a scheduling calendar. You schedule and publish everything across all platforms according to the brief. No creative decisions are required from you.

Your job in one sentence: Receive the fortnightly content package, match everything to the correct article and week, format and upload articles to WordPress for founder approval, and schedule all pins and social posts across Pinterest, Instagram, and
 in advance.

Fortnightly tasks in full:

VA hours — per fortnight (7-9 hours total):

• WordPress formatting and upload (4-6 articles) — 2-3 hours

• Brand 1Pinterest pin scheduling (20-30 pins) — 3-4 hours

• Brand 2 Pinterest pin scheduling (4-6 pins) — 30-45 mins

• Brand 2 Instagram and
 scheduling (4 posts each platform) — 40-60 mins

• Completion report with screenshots — 20-30 mins

Total VA hours per fortnight: 7-9 hours (3.5-4.5 hours per week averaged)





What You Receive Each Fortnight

Everything arrives in a shared Google Drive folder organised by week and article:



All article drafts — edited and approved, ready for WordPress formatting

All Pinterest pin graphics — pre-made, exported, and labelled by article and week

All pin descriptions — written and ready to copy-paste

All Brand 2 Instagram and
 images — pre-made and labelled by post date

All captions — written and ready to copy-paste for every platform

A scheduling calendar showing exactly which content publishes on which date



IMPORTANT: You never write captions, choose images, make strategy decisions, or create graphics. All creative and strategic work is done before the package reaches you. Your role is accurate, timely execution from a detailed brief — every fortnight, without exception.

Skills Required

WordPress — comfortable formatting posts, uploading images, filling SEO meta fields, and working with a plugin like RankMath. Previous WordPress editing experience is essential.

Pinterest Business — understands board structure, pin scheduling, and how to distribute pins across multiple boards correctly without triggering duplicate content flags.

Meta Business Suite — can schedule posts to Instagram and
 simultaneously, understands caption format differences between the two platforms.

Attention to detail — the most important skill in this role. You follow a brief exactly, every time, without shortcuts or assumptions.

Reliable and consistent — the fortnightly deadline does not move. Completion reports are expected within 72 hours of receiving the package.

Strong written English — you are copy-pasting provided captions but must read accurately and spot formatting issues before submitting.

Discretion — you will be working with confidential brand materials. A signed NDA is required before onboarding.

Preferred but not essential:

Experience with lifestyle, bridal, fashion, or travel content brands

Familiarity with editorial or magazine-style content aesthetics

Experience with Pinterest scheduling

Canva experience for minor template adjustments



Rate & Structure

Rate: USD $70 per fortnight on a fixed retainer.



Hours: Approximately 7–9 hours per fortnight (14–18 hours per month). Flexible — you choose when within the 3–4 day completion window to do the work.



Structure: Fortnightly batch. You receive the content package, complete all tasks within 3–4 days, submit your completion report with screenshots. Payment is fortnightly after successful completion of the scheduled tasks.



Start date: Immediate — looking to onboard within 2 weeks of finding the right person.



Long-term: This is an ongoing role with a growing brand. We are looking for someone who wants a reliable long-term working relationship, not a one-off project.

What Success Looks Like

Every article is correctly formatted in WordPress and set to Pending Review within 48 hours of receiving the package

Every Pinterest pin is scheduled to the correct board with the correct description — no errors in board assignment or descriptions

No pins saved to the same board twice on the same day

Every Brand 2 social post is scheduled to publish on the correct date at the correct time

Completion report with screenshots submitted within 72 hours of receiving the package

Zero errors requiring the founder to fix before approving content

How to Apply

Please include all three of the following in your application. 



1. Short introduction covering:

Your experience with WordPress, Pinterest Business, and Meta Business Suite — be specific about what you have done on each platform

Any lifestyle, bridal, fashion, travel, or editorial brands you have worked with

Why a fortnightly batch role suits you and how you manage deadlines

2. Portfolio — at least two examples from:

Screenshots of Pinterest boards or scheduled pins you have managed

Screenshots of WordPress posts you have formatted and published

Examples of Instagram or
 posts you have scheduled via Meta Business Suite

3. Complete this short test task:

This takes approximately 15 minutes. Answer all three questions in your application.



You have been given a Pinterest pin image about choosing a wedding veil for a ballgown dress, and the following description to post:



"Choosing a veil for a ballgown dress comes down to one decision — length or drama, rarely both. A cathedral veil balances the volume of a full skirt without competing with it. Read the full guide on our editorial platform."



Question 1: You have four boards available: (a) Wedding Veils, (b) Honeymoon Destinations, (c) Wedding Planning Essentials, (d) Bridal Style Inspiration. Which board would you save this pin to first, and which board — if any — would you save it to second? Explain your reasoning.



Question 2: If you saved this pin to two boards, would you do both on the same day? Why or why not?



Question 3: Before you set a WordPress article to Pending Review and submit your completion report, what are the three things you would check to make sure the article is correctly formatted?



There are no trick questions. We are looking for someone who reads instructions carefully and thinks before acting.



Brand names and full role details are shared only with shortlisted candidates after a brief screening call and a signed confidentiality agreement. We take the privacy of our brands seriously and expect the same from anyone we work with.



I am keen to see applicants who actually read the brief with a response that is not generated by chat GPT.

title: Client Operations Assistant
description:
Overview



We are hiring a Client Operations Assistant to support both our internal operations and our clients directly. This is not a standard administrative role. The right person will be comfortable navigating client-facing situations, conducting independent research, working fluently with AI tools, and taking ownership of tasks without waiting to be directed.



You will support clients by helping them understand and use our platform - guiding them through dashboards, troubleshooting account issues, and ensuring their setup is working as intended. You will also support our internal team with operations, coordination, documentation, and research.



This role suits someone who thinks ahead, communicates with clarity, and takes responsibility for outcomes rather than just effort.



---



Key Responsibilities



**Client Support**

- Help clients navigate their dashboards, accounts, and platform settings

- Respond to client queries via
 and chat with accuracy and a calm, professional tone

- Escalate issues that require technical resolution with a clear summary of what the client needs

- Proactively flag account issues before clients raise them

- Maintain accurate client records, contact data, and account notes in our CRM



**Research and Operations**

- Conduct independent research on topics relevant to client industries, platform capabilities, and competitor landscape - and produce structured, usable summaries

- Use AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, and analysis tasks

- Prepare reports, meeting notes, internal documentation, and operational briefs

- Track task progress and follow up on open items without being prompted

- Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation



**Coordination and Administration**

- Manage calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination across teams and time zones

- Handle
 communications and internal coordination with tea
mbers and partners

- Support onboarding processes for new clients and new staff

- Assist with preparation of contracts, invoices, and operational documents

- Coordinate recruitment scheduling and interview logistics



---



## Requirements



**These are required - not optional:**



- Genuine, daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent) as part of how you work. We are not looking for familiarity - we are looking for fluency.

- Strong written English.
s, summaries, and client-facing messages must be clear, professional, and free of errors.

- Research capability. You must be able to take a brief, find relevant information independently, and return a useful structured summary - not just a link dump.

- CRM experience - you have used a CRM platform to manage contacts, track interactions, and update records.

- Ability to work independently. You manage your own time, flag blockers early, and do not wait to be chased.

- Comfortable in a fast-paced remote environment with multiple concurrent priorities.

- Reliable work-from-home setup with stable internet.



**Platform Skills**

- Experience with our CRM platform is a strong advantage. We will provide training for candidates who have a solid foundation and the right instincts - platfor
chanics can be taught, but client orientation and self-direction cannot.

- Proficient in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.

- Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Notion, Trello, or equivalent) is useful.



---



Who You Are



The candidates we are looking for share a specific profile:



**You think for the client, not just about the task.** When a client raises an issue, you consider what they actually need - not just the literal request. You anticipate the follow-on question before they ask it.



**You are present.** Nothing falls through without you noticing. You are aware of what is open, what is overdue, and what is about to become a problem. You do not need to be reminded about things you own.



**You are proactive.** You act on what you observe. If you notice something is wrong or could be improved, you raise it or fix it - you do not wait for someone to ask.



**You communicate well.** Your written communication is clear, concise, and appropriate to the situation. You know when to escalate and when to resolve. You close loops.



**You are self-aware.** You know what you know, what you do not know, and when to ask. You take feedback without defensiveness and improve quickly.



---



What We Are Not Looking For



- Candidates who treat AI as a novelty rather than a daily work tool

- Candidates who need detailed step-by-step instructions for every task

- Candidates whose version of "research" is copying the first search result

- Candidates who need to be chased for updates

title: Remote Solar and Battery Sales Consultant - Australian Company
description:
About Us

Unplugged Energy is a dynamic and growing solar energy company based in Perth, Western Australia. We are passionate about helping homeowners switch to clean, renewable energy, saving them money and contributing to a greener planet. As demand for solar and batteries surges in Western Australia, we are expanding our sales team and looking for a motivated professional to join us.



The Opportunity

This is your chance to build a lucrative career in one of Australia's fastest-growing industries from the comfort of your home. We are seeking a results-driven and passionate Remote Solar & Battery Sales Consultant to join our high-performing team.

You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, converting warm, inbound leads into happy Unplugged Energy customers. This is not a lead generation role; you will be provided with qualified leads, allowing you to focus on what you do best: building rapport and closing sales. Full training on our products, systems, and the Australian solar and battery market will be provided.



What You'll Be Doing

You will be responsible for managing the entire sales process, including:

-Managing the sales@
 inbox and responding to all new customer enquiries promptly.

-Qualifying inbound leads to understand customer needs and project suitability.

-Engaging with potential customers via phone (RingCentral) and
. Strong and confident phone communication is essential for building rapport and closing deals.

-Educating clients on the financial and environmental benefits of our solar and battery solutions.

-Preparing customised, professional proposals using our Open Solar software.

-Diligently managing your sales pipeline and recording all customer interactions in our Zoho CRM system.

-Working to achieve and exceed sales targets.

-Building and maintaining long-term relationships with new and existing clients.



What We're Looking For (About You)

-A True Closer: You are a professional and dedicated individual with a tenacity for results. You aren't afraid to ask for the sale and have a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets without being pushy, confident yet consultative.

-Exceptional Communicator: You must have proficient English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a clear and easily understood speaking voice and you have experience selling to Australian or Western customers and can build trust and rapport quickly over the phone.

-Sales Experience: You have a proven track record in a full-cycle sales role, ideally in solar, renewable energy, or another high-ticket industry. You can share specific examples of sales you’ve closed, especially where the customer was hesitant at first.

-Maths & Product Knowledge: You’re confident working with numbers to calculate bills, savings, and payback periods on the spot. You can learn and recall product details for multiple brands of solar panels, inverters, and batteries.

-Tech-Savvy: You’re comfortable on a computer, confident managing multiple tabs, and quick to learn new software. We will train you on Zoho CRM and OpenSolar, but you must already be comfortable navigating web-based platforms and entering data accurately.

-Attitude: You are open-minded, flexible, hard-working, and bring a positive attitude to the team. You are a self-motivated high achiever who can work independently.

-Eager to Learn: You have a genuine passion for renewable energy and a drive to stay up-to-date on industry trends and products.

-Mindset & Work Ethic: You’re self-motivated, highly organised, and able to manage your own pipeline without constant oversight. You consistently follow through on tasks, keep your CRM clean, and deliver excellent service before, during, and after the sale.



Why You'll Love Working With Us

-100% Remote: Enjoy the stability of a full-time position from your home office.

-Excellent Remuneration: We offer a competitive base salary plus uncapped commissions. Your success determines your income.

-Warm, Qualified Leads: We generate our own leads. You will be provided with a steady stream of customers who are already interested in solar and batteries – no cold calling!

-A Product That Sells Itself: WA gets more sun than any other state in Australia, meaning our customers produce more power and save more money. With government incentives taking thousands off the cost and the ability to sell excess power back to the grid, solar is an easy decision for customers.

-Comprehensive Training & Support: We provide comprehensive training and ongoing mentorship to ensure your success.

-You will have full sales, admin, and technical support from our Perth-based team.

-Opportunity for Growth: Gain valuable skills and experience in a high-growth industry by working with a supportive and successful team.



How to Apply

If you are a driven sales professional looking for a stable, long-term remote role, we would love to hear from you.



To apply, please send the following:

-A short 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and highlighting your sales experience.

-Your updated resume and a personality profile if you have one

-A short paragraph answering the following question: "Describe your process for taking a new, warm lead from initial contact to a closed sale."

-Your expected monthly rate for the base salary component (in PHP or AUD).

-Your availability (earliest possible start date).



(Applications that do not include all of the above items will not be considered, as it helps us see who has read the full post and can follow instructions.)



We look forward to receiving your application!

- Financial Operations & Margin Control: Manage chargebacks, returns, and cost breakdowns, actively implementing strategies to protect revenue and optimize overall profitability.





Expected Outcomes (First 12 Months)

We measure success by hard results. In your first year, you are expected to:

1. Drive Gross Margin to 73%: Spearhead rigorous operational optimizations across fulfillment, inventory management, and financial workflows to increase the overall gross margin from 70% to 73%.



2. Achieve Elite Support Metrics: Lead, train, and optimize the customer support representative and processes to achieve and sustain support KPIs that rank in the top 5% of all merchants within Gorgias.



3. Elevate Brand Trust to 4.3 on Trustpilot: Completely own the post-purchase experience. Proactively manage and reduce chargebacks, streamline returns, and eliminate customer friction points to achieve and maintain a stable 4.3 Trustpilot score.





Who You Are (Competencies)

- Confidence & Decisiveness: You act decisively and trust your own judgment. You are comfortable making tough operational decisions independently and leading the team with clear authority. You are not afraid to push back respectfully to ensure projects stay on track and ultimate goals are met.



- Structure & Organization: You thrive in complexity. You seamlessly manage multiple moving parts simultaneously, bringing absolute order to the daily chaos. You build bulletproof frameworks for the team to ensure nothing slips through the cracks.



- Leadership & Accountability: You effectively manage, coach, and hold the execution team strictly accountable to their KPIs. You know how to delegate tasks clearly while maintaining high standards, ensuring the team operates efficiently.



- Proactive Problem-Solving: You anticipate bottlenecks before they happen. When issues arise, whether with a delayed shipment or a spike in support tickets, you do not just report the problem, but instantly execute a fully formed solution.



- Systematic Thinking: You view the business as an interconnected machine. You deeply understand how a delay in physical supply chain logistics directly impacts customer support volume and the 12-week recurring billing cycles. You design and implement scalable, long-term systems rather than applying temporary fixes.





Our Core Values

We hire, reward, and fire based on our core values. Do not apply if you do not fiercely align with these:

- Ambitious: You are deeply driven to win and scale. You don't just want to manage operations; you want to build the most efficient, high-performing backend in the industry. You set monumental goals and have the internal fire to achieve them.



- High Standards: You refuse to accept mediocrity. You set an exceptionally high bar for yourself, your team, and the processes you oversee. You understand that "good enough" is the enemy of great, and you consistently push for excellence.



- Obsessive: You possess a relentless, almost unreasonable drive for perfection in execution. You care deeply about the fine details, whether it is tracking down a single inventory discrepancy, optimizing a shipping route, or perfecting a support macro. You cannot rest until the system runs flawlessly.



- Open, Honest & Direct in Communication: No politics, no fluff, no ego. You communicate with radical candor. You deliver constructive feedback clearly, raise red flags immediately without fear, and appreciate the exact same directness from your founders and team.



- Curious & Eager to Learn: You have an insatiable growth mindset. You do not assume you know everything; instead, you are constantly seeking new knowledge, exploring better systems, and analyzing data. You are highly coachable and proactively look for ways to level up yourself and the business every single day.





How to Apply

We do not read standard cover letters. To apply, please submit a Video Application covering the following:

1. A short introduction about yourself.



2. Why you are a perfect fit for this role and our core values.



3. A quick tour of your workspace so we can see how you structure your daily environment.

title: Senior Operations Lead / Head of Operations
description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Operations Lead / Head of Operations for our DTC e-commerce business.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can bring structure, accountability, and execution across daily operations. 

The goal is to make the business more organized, improve operational visibility, reduce founder dependency, and ensure work gets done properly across teams. This role may involve managing operations across multiple stores/pods, so we need someone who can build one strong operating system and apply it consistently across different brands when required. 

This is not a corporate COO role. We need a strong operator who can think strategically but also execute, follow up, build systems, and solve problems.



Key Responsibilities

1. Daily Operations & Execution

  -Oversee day-to-day operations across the business.

  -Track priorities, deadlines, blockers, and follow-ups.

  -Make sure tasks are completed and owners are accountable.

  -Apply the same operating rhythm across multiple stores when required.

  - Improve communication and execution between departments.



2. KPI & Scorecard Management

  -Maintain weekly KPI tracking and business scorecards.

  -Monitor key metrics such as revenue trend, MER, refunds, subscription churn, CX response time, chargebacks, inventory days, fulfillment issues, AOV, and upsell performance.

  -Ensure every KPI has a clear owner, source of truth, and action plan when off-track.



3. Customer Experience Operations

  -Track support quality, response time, resolution time, complaints, refunds, and escalations.

  -Identify recurring customer issues and create feedback loops with product, fulfillment, and leadership.

  -Help reduce avoidable refunds, complaints, and trust issues.



4. Fulfillment, Inventory & Supply Chain

  -Coordinate with fulfillment partners, suppliers, and internal teams.

  -Track inventory, shipping issues, delivery complaints, and stockout risks.

  -Escalate risks early and help create SOPs for recurring fulfillment processes.



5. SOPs, Systems & Reporting

  -Build and improve SOPs, checklists, workflows, and reporting systems.

  -Prepare weekly leadership updates showing what moved, what is stuck, what is at risk, and what decisions are needed.

  -Reduce dependency on verbal instructions and create simple systems the team can actually use.



Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

  -Highly organized and detail-oriented

  -Strong with follow-up and accountability

  -Comfortable with KPIs, dashboards, and spreadsheets

  -Good at solving messy operational problems

  -Clear in communication

  -Calm under pressure

  -Hands-on, not just a delegator

  -Comfortable working directly with founders/leadership

  -Able to manage multiple departments without constant direction



Requirements

-3+ years of experience in operations, e-commerce, project management, or business management.

-Experience managing cross-functional execution.

-Experience with KPIs, scorecards, SOPs, dashboards, or reporting.

-Strong written communication and documentation skills.

-Ability to manage multiple priorities across different stores, pods, or departments.

-Comfortable using tools like Google Sheets, Slack, ClickUp, Notion, Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, Klaviyo, or similar tools.

-Experience in DTC e-commerce, supplements, wellness, customer support, fulfillment, or subscription businesses is a strong plus.

-Experience managing multiple stores, brands, pods, or product lines is preferred.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  -Weekly operations are clearly tracked.

  -Department owners are accountable.

  -Important numbers are visible.

  -Fewer tasks are missed.

  -CX, fulfillment, inventory, and finance risks are caught early.

  -SOPs and systems are documented.

  -Leadership spends less time chasing updates.

  -The business runs more smoothly every week.



What This Role Is Not

This is not a pure strategy role.

   -This is not a marketing or creative role.

   -This is not a corporate COO role.

   -This is not for someone who only gives ideas but does not execute.

   -We need someone who can organize the business, follow up with people, solve operational problems, and make execution happen.

title: Funnel Page Developer — DTC Health/Supplement Brand (Replo + Liquid)
description:
We run a fast-moving DTC health brand and need a reliable contractor to build out our upsell/downsell funnel pages on an ongoing per-project basis. If you've built post-purchase funnels for supplement, telehealth, or e-commerce brands before, this is straightforward work you can probably knock out in a few hours per page.

What you'll be building

Each "funnel" typically includes:



1 long-form sales lander (hero, narrative sections, comparison table, FAQ, CTA blocks)

2–3 OTO (one-time-offer) upsell pages

1–2 downsell pages

Occasional standalone offer pages, thank-you pages, and quiz pages



All pages are built as single-file Liquid/HTML+CSS components that paste directly into Replo Custom Code blocks. Mobile-first (max-width ~480px for OTOs), responsive, no external dependencies, all styles scoped so they don't bleed into the rest of the site.

Requirements



Strong HTML/CSS — clean, hand-written, semantic. No frameworks or build tools, no Tailwind, no jQuery

Comfortable with Shopify Liquid syntax (variables, assigns, comments — we don't use complex Liquid logic)

You've worked with Replo, Funnelish, ClickFunnels, ShoGun, or similar page builders

Mobile-first design instincts — most traffic is mobile

Pixel-accurate work from reference screenshots

Vanilla JS only when needed (countdown timers, simple toggles)

Reliable turnaround and clear communication



Nice to have



Direct-response copywriting eye (you'll spot when copy doesn't fit the offer and flag it)

Experience with health/supplement compliance norms (FTC disclosures, claim language)

Light SVG/illustration skills for placeholder graphics



How we work

We send you a reference screenshot or design + the offer details (product, price, copy direction). You return a single Liquid file we paste into Replo. One round of revisions included. Variables at the top of every file so we can swap prices, URLs, and product names without touching the markup.

Compensation

Flat rate per funnel page. Bundle pricing available for multi-page funnels.

We'd like to find someone we can work with on an ongoing basis as new offers launch weekly.

To apply



Send 2–3 examples of funnel pages or landers you've built (links or screenshots)

Confirm your typical turnaround for a single OTO page and a long-form lander

Start your message with the word "bundle" so we know you actually read this

Optional but appreciated: a short note on your passions and hobbies.



Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: UGC & Creator Manager
description:
About KOBEES

KOBEES is a fast-growing beeswax-based personal care brand based in Las Vegas, USA. We make clean, plastic-free lip balms, hand salves, and body care products sold on Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop. We've been featured on Shark Tank and are scaling aggressively through paid social and creator-driven content.

We are a small, tight-knit team that moves fast and holds a high bar for quality. Every person on this team owns their lane completely.



The Role

We are building a roster of 10–20 UGC creators who can produce content for our paid and organic channels on an ongoing basis. We need someone to own this program end-to-end — finding creators, building relationships, managing briefs, tracking deliverables, and keeping the roster active and healthy.

This is not a social media management job. You will not be posting content or running ads. Your job is to make sure we always have a pipeline of quality content coming in from creators who know our brand and can deliver fast.

This role is fully owned by you. We expect minimal hand-holding.



What You'll Do



Source and vet new UGC creators on TikTok and Instagram that fit the KOBEES brand

Reach out to creators with personalized, on-brand outreach messages

Onboard new creators — send products, share brand guidelines, answer questions

Write clear creative briefs so creators know exactly what to make

Manage the content calendar and track every deliverable from brief to delivery

Follow up consistently — you own getting content in on time, every time

Maintain a CRM or tracker with full visibility into creator status, payment, usage rights, and performance

Flag top-performing creators and recommend who to continue working with

Handle creator payments and contracts in coordination with our team

Proactively suggest new creators, new content angles, and ways to improve the program





What We're Looking For

Required:



2+ years of experience managing a UGC or influencer program for a DTC or ecommerce brand — not social media management, specifically creator/UGC coordination

Strong written English — your outreach messages and briefs represent our brand

Highly organized with a clear system for managing multiple creators and deadlines simultaneously

Proactive communicator — you chase deliverables, you don't wait to be reminded

Familiar with TikTok and Instagram — you can quickly evaluate whether a creator is a good fit



Preferred:



Experience with beauty, wellness, or personal care brands

Familiar with tools like Airtable, Notion, or similar for tracking

Has managed a creator roster of 10+ people at once

Comfortable managing small creator payments and tracking contracts





What This Job Is Not



This is not an entry-level role. We are not looking to train someone from scratch.

This is not a social media manager role. Do not apply if your experience is primarily posting content or running brand accounts.

This is not a low-effort job. We move fast and expect the same.





How to Apply

Do not send a generic application. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

In your application, include:



A brief description of a UGC or creator program you've managed — how many creators, what brand, and how you kept it organized

An example of an outreach message you've written (or would write) to a TikTok creator for a natural lip balm brand

How you would handle a creator who is two weeks late on their deliverable and has gone quiet

What tools you use to track creator deliverables and why

 Address

title: Senior Financial Accountant
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly capable and detail-oriented Senior Financial Accountant to join our growing finance team supporting Australian businesses across multiple industries, including logistics, operations, security, and professional services.



This role is ideal for someone with strong technical accounting knowledge, experience working with Australian businesses or accounting standards, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in financial reporting, compliance, reconciliations, forecasting, process improvement, and supporting strategic financial operations.



Key Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Accounting

Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports

Manage month-end and year-end close processes

Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and reconciliations

Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts

Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules

Monitor cash flow reporting and financial performance

Assist with budgeting and forecasting processes

Support multi-entity and intercompany accounting activities

Compliance & Tax

Assist with Australian tax compliance requirements including:

BAS/GST

Payroll reconciliations

Superannuation reporting

FBT and other statutory obligations

Assist with external audits and financial statement preparation

Ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal controls

Systems & Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to automate and improve finance processes

Work with ERP/accounting systems and reporting tools

Assist with implementation and optimisation of financial systems

Maintain accuracy and integrity of financial data

Operational & Business Support

Support leadership with financial insights and reporting

Assist with financial analysis and performance tracking

Collaborate with operations and management teams

Mentor junior finance or bookkeeping staff where required

Skills & Experience Required

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

CPA, CA, or equivalent qualification preferred

Minimum 5 years’ experience in accounting or finance roles

Experience supporting Australian businesses highly preferred

Strong understanding of Australian accounting principles and compliance requirements

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

Experience with Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks, Odoo, or ERP systems

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

High attention to detail and strong organisational skills

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a remote environment

Preferred Experience

Experience working remotely with Australian companies

Experience in logistics, transport, operations, or professional services industries

Familiarity with business intelligence or automation tools

Experience with multi-entity business structures

Team leadership or mentoring experience

Working Hours

Full-time role

Must be available during Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT)

What We Offer

Long-term remote opportunity

Career growth and development

Exposure to Australian business operations

Supportive and fast-growing business environment

Opportunity to work across multiple entities and projects

About the Company



KhanTrix is a business infrastructure, operations, and growth company supporting businesses through systems, finance, operations, technology, and strategic development.



The role may also involve supporting associated entities including:



MFLC Logistics

KT Security Group

Other affiliated businesses within the group structure
