title: Customer Experience & Operations Associate (E-commerce Coffee Company) *Full Time, Remote | Long-Term Growth Opportunity
description:
Are you ready…

To start a role that motivates and excites you?

And a position where we invest in your learning, education, and growth?



Then keep reading, we want to work with you!





WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS POSITION:

This is not your typical support role — you’ll work directly with our founders, influence company-wide systems, and gain exposure to every part of the business.



Incredible company culture:

• Small, close team with collaborative, friendly and open culture.

• We believe the biggest asset of a company is our people. We focus on helping each tea
mber reach their full potential by investing in their learning, growth, skills, and education. When we grow as individuals, we succeed as a team.

• Not a fan of office politics or drama? We’re on the same page. Instead of wasting time with that, we focus on solving problems and reaching goals

• 100% remote, enjoy the comfort and flexibility of working from home



Pay, benefits, progression, and long-term growth:

• Competitive salary

• Benefits including up to 16 days a year Paid Time off

• Progression as we grow: greater responsibilities, leadership opportunities, and increased pay.

• Feel empowered, make decisions, have an impact

• Grow with the company and live up to your potential!

• Join an exciting, fast-growing company!







ABOUT US:

We’re a young, ambitious, and small (but growing!) company that’s making a massive impact in ecommerce. 



Since 2015 we’ve been obsessed with building award-winning products and awesome brands that people fall in love with. We have 2 primary brands in our portfolio: 

(1) an international award-winning coffee products brand 
 / 
).

(2) an educational coaching program that helps entrepreneurs grow their businesses to create a positive impact in the world!



Our two recent flagship products became the world’s most successful launches in their categories. We’ve shipped more than 200,000 orders worldwide and we’re continuing to expand.



Our culture is transparent and candid. You’re always welcome (and encouraged!) to ask questions or express a difference of opinion. Learning and growth is a cornerstone of our culture, both personally and professionally. We work hard, and we have fun!







WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We’re looking for a proactive and detail-oriented team player to fill this role—someone who thrives on solving problems, staying organized, and making things run smoothly across departments.



Do you love helping customers, supporting a team, and keeping operations organized? Do you get satisfaction from making systems work better and “getting things done”? If yes, we want you on our team!



You’re probably the type of person who:

• Enjoys supporting others and finding solutions to problems

• Has strong communication and organizational skills

• Likes working behind the scenes to make sure everything runs like clockwork

• Is excited to wear multiple hats and be part of a growing, fast-moving company

• Has worked directly with founders or in a startup, and enjoys that fast-paced, flexible vibe

We’re not just looking for someone who can support our team, we’re looking for someone to be proactive with taking ownership of tasks, solve problems independently, and grow into larger responsibilities over time.







YOUR OPPORTUNITY AND ROLE ON THE TEAM:

Our culture is collaborative, friendly, and open. We hire people who are smart, ambitious, and have a strong desire to learn and grow.



Sound like you? This is an exciting long-term opportunity!



This is a fully remote position. You’ll work directly with our founders and collaborate with our small but mighty team to support customer happiness, streamline operations, and take on projects that help the business grow. 



This is a foundational role — one where you’ll gain visibility into all parts of the company.



As you grow, your role will grow with you, based on your interests and strengths:

• Want to work improving our systems and processes? Awesome!

• Have ideas on how to improve our website? Fantastic!

• Want to learn how to manage projects? Let’s go!



We’re not just hiring for a role — we’re hiring for potential. 



Your responsibilities will span 4 key areas: customer experience (30-40%), operations/logistics (20-30%), executive support (10-20%), and special projects (10-20%) — giving you exposure across the business. These percentages are estimates and you can expect your day-to-day to shift and evolve as the business grows and as you take ownership. 



1. Customer Experience

• Provide
/chat-based support for our customers across our channels (Shopify, Amazon, and wholesale)

• Answer order and product questions, resolve issues promptly, and ensure customers feel heard and supported

• Support wholesale partners with order updates, invoicing, and coordination



2. Order Management & Platform Coordination

• Manage, monitor, and troubleshoot orders across Shopify, Amazon, and wholesale channels

• Troubleshoot and resolve shipping or fulfillment issues with partners and customers

• Maintain accurate product listings, inventory data, and logistics information across platforms



3. Executive & Admin Support

• Manage founder and team inboxes, schedule meetings, and organize internal documentation

• Assist with travel bookings, meeting preparation, and note-taking

• Support small projects by tracking timelines, managing tasks, and ensuring follow-through



4. Special Projects & Company Operations

• Conduct research projects to support decision-making (tools, systems, competitors)

• Support lead generation efforts through identifying new wholesale prospects, brand partners, or influencers

• Support planning and execution of events, expos, or marketing campaigns — manage timelines, logistics, and tasks

• Document and maintain SOPs for operational clarity and training

• Test and troubleshoot web pages, workflows, or customer journeys to ensure quality and functionality

• Take ownership of ad hoc “figure it out” tasks — we’ll guide you, but we value initiative and independent problem-solving mindset



You’ll be trained on all platforms and tools, and we’ll support your learning — but we’re looking for someone who’s excited to take initiative and build systems along the way. This role evolves — as you grow, so will your responsibilities.







ABOUT YOU / REQUIRED SKILLS OR EXPERIENCE:

We value curiosity, reliability, and the ability to take ownership. If you enjoy figuring things out, learning on the job, and taking initiative, you’ll thrive here. This role is not a fit if you need constant direction or struggle to manage your own time.



Must have experience:

• 2+ years of experience in a customer service or operations support role 
/chat-based)

• 1+ years experience in eCommerce environments (Shopify, Amazon, etc.)

• Fluent in written and spoken English



Key traits:

• Strong detail orientation, organizational, and time-management skills — you’re detail-obsessed and on top of things

• Proactive problem-solver — you take initiative, do the research, and follow through

• Able to work independently, ask questions when needed, and communicate clearly

• Comfortable with constructive feedback and direct, respectful communication



Optional but a big plus:

• Experience coordinating projects, events, or marketing campaigns is a plus

• Experience with executive assistant work 
/calendar/travel management)

• Experience improving or documenting processes (SOPs)

• Experience at a startup or small business where you wore multiple hats

• “Experience coordinating projects, events, or marketing campaigns is a plus”







PAY, WORKING HOURS, HOW TO APPLY

If this description seems like it’s too intimidating for you, this position is probably not for you. However, if you’re still here reading and this sounds exciting for you, we’d love to meet you!



The full time monthly salary will be $
based on your skills and level of relevant experience. Being a member of our team has other benefits including up to 16 days of paid time off per year.



We understand you may have a busy schedule, so we’ve made our interview process extremely quick and efficient. 



To apply, please follow the steps below:

1. Get started with a quick Initial Screening here for us to get to know you: 

2. Complete the screening and we’ll be in touch with next steps once we receive it.





The position is on a first come first review basis, so the sooner you complete the screening, the more likely you'll get hired.



Good luck, and we hope to have someone awesome like you to join us!

title: Sales Manager
description:
Record Label Music & Sales Manager (Remote)



Pex Life Records LLC: Our Vision for Transformative Music



Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
If your instinct when something breaks is to fix the pipeline before fixing the symptom — this role was built for you.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You're not here to deploy code and move on. You're here to make sure the systems that deliver that code are reliable, secure, automated, and continuously improving.

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who thinks in pipelines, not tasks. You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our development and client environments running — CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, cloud platforms, monitoring, and security. When something breaks, you find the root cause. When something works, you ask how to make it more reliable, more automated, and less dependent on human intervention next time.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best DevOps engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

They treat manual processes as technical debt. If something requires a human to do it repeatedly, their instinct is to eliminate that dependency — not just document it

They take ownership. From the 
nt an infrastructure problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's resolved, documented, and hardened against happening again

They think in systems. They don't just fix what's broken — they ask what else could break, and why, and build accordingly

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and deployment risks are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. The DevOps landscape moves fast. Twelve months from now they know more than they do today — because they made sure of it



Who Thrives Here



People who are technically sharp, operationally minded, and genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that just works. You don't wait to be handed a list of things to automate — you find them. You're comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful under pressure, and you care more about system reliability than staying in a defined lane.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. For the right engineer, that's not a warning — it's the opportunity to build things the right way from the ground up.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where development pipelines, Linux infrastructure, cloud systems, and client integrations all need an engineer who can own them end-to-end. Your job isn't just to keep things running — it's to make them run better, more reliably, and with less human intervention every month.

That looks like:



Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that make deployments fast, reliable, and repeatable — so shipping code is a non-event, not a risk

Managing and administering Linux servers (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) across development and client environments — knowing these systems well enough to troubleshoot them at any layer

Administering web servers (Nginx, Apache) and databases — keeping them performant, secure, and maintainable

Implementing client-requested integrations — understanding what's being asked, translating it into a reliable technical solution, and delivering it cleanly

Conducting root cause analysis on production errors — not just fixing what's visible, but understanding what allowed it to happen and building the safeguard that prevents it

Building scripts and automation (Bash required; Python and PHP a plus) that eliminate repetitive manual work from the team's daily operations

Monitoring infrastructure, resource utilization, and security events — building alerting systems that catch problems before they become i

Designing and enforcing DevSecOps practices — making security a built-in part of the pipeline, not an afterthought

Working with cloud platforms and virtualization — managing hypervisors and cloud service providers with the confidence of someone who's done it in production



What We're Looking For



Proven experience in Linux server administration (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) — you know these systems well enough to manage, troubleshoot, and optimize them without a guide

Hands-on CI/CD experience — you've built and maintained real pipelines, not just used them; you know what makes a deployment safe and what makes it a liability

Strong version control administration — Git, remote repositories, branching strategies, code review workflows; you manage these with intention, not just habit

Web server administration experience — Nginx and Apache, configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

Database administration experience — you can manage database servers, optimize queries, and keep data environments healthy

Bash scripting proficiency (required) — you write automation that works, that others can read, and that makes the team faster; Python and PHP experience is a plus

Solid cloud computing and virtualization experience — working with hypervisors and cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent) in real production environments

Infrastructure and event monitoring experience — you build alerting systems that surface the right information at the right time, not noise

Understanding of DevSecOps — you treat security as part of the build, not something bolted on at the end

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of a production issue, not just the fastest path to closing the ticket

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you surface risks and blockers clearly and early, even when the news isn't good

Long-term mindset — you want to build something that lasts, not move on when things get complex





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our infrastructure, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape the infrastructure, the pipelines, and how we build.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.





What Success Looks Like



At three months: You have a clear picture of the infrastructure landscape — what's healthy, what's fragile, and what needs to be rebuilt. At least one significant manual process has been automated. Your documentation is already what the team references.

At six months: Deployments are more reliable and less stressful than when you joined. Monitoring is catching problems before they become i
. The team is spending less time on reactive firefighting and more time building.

At twelve months: The infrastructure is measurably more stable, secure, and automated than before you joined. You've built systems the team depends on — and you're already identifying the next layer of improvement. 
 is investing in your next step.





How We Work



You won't be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients and internal teams depend on the infrastructure you manage — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the infrastructure, automations, and systems that make us better as we grow.





This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a defined list of tasks to know what to work on

You deploy the fix without asking what caused the failure

You treat documentation and runbooks as someone else's job

You're comfortable with fragile systems as long as they're currently running

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You're looking for a low-pressure remote role with predictable, well-defined work

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.





What We Offer





Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: CARRIER SALES REPRESENTATIVE (CAPACITY & OWNER-OPERATOR DEVELOPMENT)
description:
Alternative Titles (for sourcing reach)



* Carrier Sales Representative

* Carrier Sales Specialist

* Capacity Manager

* Carrier Relations Specialist

* Trucking Capacity Coordinator

* Freight Capacity Representative

* Logistics Capacity Manager

* Carrier Procurement Specialist



---



 ???? **Location:**



Remote (Philippines-Based Preferred)



---



???? **Employment Type:**



Full-Time



---



 ???? **Compensation:**



Base Salary:  $400 – $800 USD per month (based on experience and performance)

Commission: 3% – 7% of gross margin (based on loads successfully covered)

Performance Bonuses:  Based on load coverage speed, carrier reliability, and capacity growth



---



 ???? **Role Summary:**



We are building a high-growth logistics operation focused on:



* Freight brokerage (trucking first)

* Expansion into air, ocean, and rail

* Carrier network development

* Owner-operator partnerships

* Regional trucking expansion



We are seeking a **Carrier Sales Representative (Capacity & Owner-Operator Development)** responsible for securing carrier capacity, validating carriers, and building a reliable network of carriers and owner-operators.



This role is critical to ensuring that every load is covered efficiently, while also building the foundation of a scalable trucking network starting in:



* Savannah, Georgia / South Carolina region

* Jacksonville, Florida

* Charleston, South Carolina



---



 ???? **Core Responsibilities:**



 1. Carrier Sourcing & Capacity Building (Primary Responsibility)



* Identify and secure carriers to cover loads provided by the Freight Broker

* Source carriers through:



  * Load boards

  * Direct outreach (calls, messages)

  * Existing relationships

* Build a reliable and scalable carrier network



---



 2. Carrier Negotiation



* Negotiate rates with carriers within broker-approved pricing ranges

* Ensure loads are covered at or below target carrier cost

* Balance cost, service, and reliability



---



 3. Carrier Validation (Critical Responsibility)



* Perform full carrier validation before assigning loads, including:



  * Insurance verification

  * Authority checks

  * Safety records

  * Compliance verification



* Maintain internal records of approved carriers



* Ensure only qualified and reliable carriers are used



???? **Note:** Carrier sourcing and carrier validation are both owned by the Carrier Sales Representative



---



 4. Owner-Operator Development (Primary Strategic Focus)



* Actively recruit and build relationships with owner-operators



* Bring owner-operators into our network to:



  * Cover loads internally

  * Support regional trucking buildout



* Focus on building a **quasi-trucking network** (without initial ownership of trucks)



---



 5. Regional Network Development (Strategic Responsibility)



* Focus on building carrier and owner-operator networks in:



  * Savannah (first priority)

  * Jacksonville (second)

  * Charleston (third)



* Support long-term plan to:



  * Establish trucking operations in each region

  * Transition from brokered capacity to controlled capacity



---



 6. Load Coverage Execution



* Receive loads from Freight Broker

* Secure carriers quickly and efficiently

* Ensure coverage aligns with:



  * Pricing targets

  * Service requirements



---



 7. Owner-Operator Load Support



* Work directly with owner-operators to:



  * Ensure they receive consistent loads

  * Match them with appropriate freight



* Coordinate with:



  * Internal brokerage loads

  * External load opportunities when applicable



---



 8. External Load Sourcing for Capacity (When Applicable)



* Identify opportunities to secure loads for owner-operators outside the internal ecosystem, when:



  * Capacity is underutilized

  * It is operationally beneficial

  * It is legally and contractually permissible



* Work with:



  * External brokers

  * Direct customers



* Coordinate with Dispatch for execution



---



 ???? **Freight Factoring & Payment Flow Awareness:**



* All completed loads are paid through **freight factoring partners**



* Upon load completion:



  * 90%–95% of load value is advanced

  * Remaining 5%–10% is collected later



* Carrier Sales must:



  * Ensure proper documentation for payment

  * Understand that reliable execution directly impacts payment timelines



---



 ???? **What This Role Does NOT Do:**



* Does not set final pricing with shippers

* Does not manage customer relationships (primary ownership)

* Does not dispatch loads

* Does not handle shipment tracking



---



 ???? **Required Experience:**



* 1–3+ years in carrier sales, dispatch, or freight brokerage

* Experience working with carriers or owner-operators

* Strong understanding of trucking operations



---



 ???? **Required Skills:**



* Strong negotiation and communication skills

* Ability to move quickly and cover loads under time pressure

* Strong organizational and multitasking ability

* Understanding of carrier compliance and validation processes

* Relationship-building with carriers and owner-operators



---



 ???? **Preferred Experience:**



* Experience building carrier networks

* Experience working with owner-operators directly

* Experience in high-volume brokerage environments

* Exposure to multimodal logistics (air, ocean, rail)



---



 ???? **First 30 Days Expectations:**



* Begin sourcing and validating carriers immediately

* Build initial carrier network in Savannah-focused lanes

* Successfully cover loads assigned by Freight Broker

* Start identifying and onboarding owner-operators

* Establish baseline carrier relationships



---



 ???? **Reporting Structure:**



* Reports directly to: Freight Broker (Pricing Lead) / Founder

* Works closely with:



  * Dispatch

  * Shipper Sales



---



 ???? **Growth Opportunity:**



* Opportunity to grow into:



  * Senior Carrier Sales

  * Capacity Manager

  * Regional Fleet / Trucking Manager



* Direct involvement in building future trucking operations



---



 ???? **Position Overview:**



This role is a blend of execution and strategic growth. The Carrier Sales Representative is responsible not only for covering loads, but also for building the carrier and owner-operator foundation that will evolve into a scalable trucking operation across multiple regions.

title: Marketplace Manager - Multi Brand
description:
Full time career opportunity – diverse B2B/B2C Marketing & Marketplace role in consumer products – growing responsibilities

A great long term career opportunity awaits a driven, agile, digital-savvy, hungry-to-learn individual who wants to take on growing responsibilities in using AI to drive digital sales and marketing for two exciting Australian consumer brands.

I own two established consumer brands (both have been around for over 50 years), historically operating in the wholesale space (800+ stockists). Over the last couple of years, the B2C channel has grown in importance and its simply too much workload for me to manage.

Your workload would consist of managing all aspects of our marketplace sale (Amazon, eBay, Iconic, Faire, Fieldfolio, Fruugo and several others) from listing products to improving discoverability and conversion. You will implement digital support projects (eg editing product images in Canva, generating AI images for digital ads, managing & optimising google ads, updating online marketplace listings on eBay, Amazon etc) as well as responding to social media posts and posting pro-actively on social media. You are expected to explore how to use AI tools to make this work more efficient.

Ideally, you already have experience in digital marketplaces, consider yourself a fast learner and self-starter who is willing to take on additional responsibilities to support all sales activity through all our digital sales channels. You have a can-do attitude and are comfortable handling multiple tasks simultaneously. You are driven by success.

Advanced Microsoft office experience is required, including having previously managed online marketplaces such as eBay and Amazon. You are focussed on improving sales and have experience using tools such as Canva and AI image generation. You have capability to manage Google Ads and have some experience with AI tools such as Claude Cowork, Gemini and are keen to trial new tools in this space. Any challenges you face that are not defined by our procedures, you are willing to research yourself (eg youtube videos) to figure out how to do something.

The role is fulltime with salary increases over time in line with increased responsibilities. Hours are Monday to Friday and we honor most Filipino holidays except for All Saints and All Souls Day. Once you complete your 6 months’ probation, you are eligible for a 13th month salary.

This is a fantastic full-time career opportunity and the owner of the business is willing to invest a lot of time into your development. As such, if you are only after a short-term contract or prefer to continue doing some gig-work on the side, this role is not for you.

title: Property & Casualty Insurance Bookkeeping / Admin Virtual Assistant (Remote)
description:
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant with experience in Property & Casualty Insurance bookkeeping and administrative operations. This remote, part-time role requires a dedicated commitment of 25 hours per week on a fixed schedule aligned with the EST time zone. In this position, you will support daily accounting, payment processing, commission tracking, reconciliations, and insurance system management for a growing insurance agency. The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, and capable of learning complex systems quickly while maintaining absolute accuracy in a fast-paced environment.



Key Responsibilities

Your primary focus will cover insurance accounting and bookkeeping, which involves entering and applying client payments accurately within agency management systems, tracking and reconciling commission statements, and assisting with accounts receivable. You will also review invoices, billing records, and transaction discrepancies, alongside preparing necessary bookkeeping and accounting reports.

For insurance administrative support, you will update policy and client information in agency management systems, maintain accurate digital records, and assist with policy billing workflows. Additionally, you will follow up on missing information, support internal operational reporting, work within insurance management platforms, maintain organized workflow tracking, and proactively escalate issues with potential solutions.



Mandatory Experience & Qualifications

To be considered for this role, prior experience in Property & Casualty Insurance operations as well as direct bookkeeping or insurance accounting experience is strictly mandatory. You must possess a strong understanding of payment processing and reconciliations, a high level of accuracy and reliability, and excellent attention to detail. Candidates must be able to work independently with minimal supervision, adapt to complex systems quickly, and demonstrate strong written and verbal English communication skills. A reliable internet connection and a functional remote work setup are required. Preferred but not required experience includes familiarity with NowCerts, AM570, or similar insurance agency management systems, proficiency in Microsoft Excel, and specific knowledge of insurance commission processing



Success Measures

Success in this role means ensuring the accurate and timely processing of payments and commissions while reducing the operational workload for agency leadership. You will be expected to require minimal supervision after onboarding, maintain consistent and organized workflow management, complete all tasks on time, and communicate proactively to resolve issues



How to Apply

If you meet all the mandatory requirements and are ready to commit to a fixed EST schedule, please send us your updated CV, a brief introduction video, and your active WhatsApp number.

title: Paid Ads Specialist
description:
WHO WE ARE

We’re not a typical health clinic. 

Averus Group operates two health and wellness brands — Cerebral Health and Magnolia Hyperbarics — delivering advanced neurological and physical treatments including PEMF, HBOT, and Neurofeedback. Our patients come to us when conventional medicine hasn’t worked. We get results because we hold ourselves to an exceptional standard across every function of the business — including marketing.

We’re building an in-house team that owns outcomes, not just outputs. That means the people we hire aren’t task-completers — they’re operators who understand that the quality of their work directly affects whether a patient walks through our door and gets the help they need.





THE ROLE 

Own the paid acquisition engine across two brands

This isn't a role where you run campaigns and report impressions. You own the full paid acquisition function across Google and Meta for Cerebral Health and Magnolia Hyperbarics — and you're accountable for one thing: qualified patient bookings at a measurable cost.

You'll inherit an account with a proven track record — 4.17x exam ROAS, 15.6x treatment plan ROAS — and your job is to protect, optimize, and scale that performance. You monitor spend daily, test creative systematically, coordinate across CRM and web, and report in business terms. Revenue influenced. Not impressions delivered.

Our marketing performance is a direct reflection of patient volume. When you do your job well, more patients get access to life-changing treatment. That’s the standard we hold ourselves to- and the one we’re hiring for. 



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Day-to-day, here's what this looks like.

• Google Ads

  • Manage all Google Search campaigns across education, evaluation, and local intent stages.

  • Monitor keyword performance daily — pause underperformers, scale winners.

  • Own bidding strategies, quality scores, and ad copy A/B tests.

  • Ensure conversion tracking is firing accurately across GA4 and GHL.

• Meta Ads 
 & Instagram)

  • Run the full funnel — TOF prospecting, MOF warm retargeting, BOF high-intent retargeting.

  • Brief the creative team on format, hook direction, CTA, and compliance requirements.

  • Test one variable at a time with a clear hypothesis before every creative test.

  • Track frequency, relevance scores, and audience fatigue — adjust before performance drops.

• Reporting & Coordination

  • Report ROAS at exam level and treatment plan level — not cost-per-lead.

  • Surface issues within 48 hours. Not at the monthly review.

  • Coordinate with the CRM Specialist to ensure leads enter the right GHL sequences.

  • Maintain consistent UTM parameters and attribution accuracy across all campaigns.





YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF...

This role is for operators, not order-takers.

• You've actually run Google Search campaigns.

Not just smart campaigns or broad matches — hands-on search with custom intent targeting, negative keywords, and bid strategy management.

• You know Meta beyond boosted posts.

Custom audiences, lookalikes, retargeting funnels, CAPI — you've built and managed them, not just watched them run.

• You speak in revenue, not reach.

Your first instinct when reviewing a campaign is ROAS and cost per acquisition — not impressions or follower growth.

• You flag problems before they compound.

You're watching the account daily. If something breaks or underperforms, you surface it within 48 hours with a recommendation — not a status update.

• You understand healthcare ad policy.

You know what copy triggers a flag on Meta or Google and you don't wait to find out the hard way.

• You have the first 30 days mapped in your head already.

You're thinking about account structure, tracking integrity, and quick wins before you've even applied.



WHAT YOU'LL GET

We take care of the people who take care of our patients.

• Paid Time Off — Recharge so you can perform at your best. We respect the time you take away from work.

• Sick Days — When life happens, it happens. Take the time you need to recover without the pressure.

• Fully Remote — Work from the Philippines with a team spread across time zones — autonomy and flexibility built in.

• Real Growth — This is a growing organization. As both brands scale, so do the opportunities for the people building them.

• A Team That Cares — We hire people who are bought into the mission. You'll work alongside others who understand why the work matters, not just what the work is.

• A Greater Mission — Every qualified booking you drive is a patient who gets access to treatment that could change their life. That's not marketing copy — that's the reality of what we do.



Ready to apply?

Send us your ad account screenshots showing ROAS data, campaign structure, and at least one before/after optimization. Show us your thinking — not just the results.

title: Electrical Estimator Virtual Assistant
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly analytical Electrical Estimator Virtual Assistant to support residential and commercial electrical contracting projects. This is a full-time role designed to support estimating operations, improve workflow efficiency, and reduce the day-to-day workload of the business owner. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience preparing accurate estimates and takeoffs directly from architectural plans, even in cases where dedicated electrical plans are not provided. We are looking for someone who is comfortable learning and adapting to client-specific estimating processes and is open to completing a test project during our evaluation process.



Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will review architectural, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical plans to execute project estimations effectively. You will be responsible for preparing accurate electrical takeoffs and estimates using Microsoft Excel for both residential and commercial electrical projects. Your analytical skills will be used to thoroughly review project requirements, allowing you to identify potential scope gaps, flag missing details, and proactively recommend possible solutions. Additionally, you will organize and maintain estimating documentation, coordinate closely with the business owner regarding project requirements or revisions, and support overall administrative estimating tasks while maintaining clear workflows



Mandatory Experience & Qualifications

To qualify for this position, you must have previous experience in electrical estimating or construction estimation, paired with a proven ability to read and interpret complex architectural and construction plans. Direct experience estimating projects without complete electrical plans is strictly required. You must possess strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, sharp analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail. Candidates must be able to work independently with minimal supervision and demonstrate strong written and verbal English communication skills.



While not strictly mandatory, we highly prefer candidates who bring experience with both residential and commercial electrical projects, familiarity with New York City construction environments and workflows, and a background working directly with U.S.-based contractors. A solid understanding of standard construction takeoff processes and estimation workflows is also a major plus.



How to Apply

We’re building an in-house team that owns outcomes, not just outputs. That means the people we hire aren’t task-completers — they’re operators who understand that the quality of their work directly affects whether a patient walks through our door and gets the help they need.





THE ROLE 

Create content that moves people; and moves them to book. 

This is a combined role for someone who is equally strong in short-form video editing and organic social media management. You'll edit raw clinic footage from Cerebral Health and Magnolia Hyperbarics into platform-native content — and then own everything that happens after it's published.

Community engagement, DM management, content calendar, lead routing, and monthly reporting — this is your function. You're not a content scheduler. You're the person who understands that a comment or a DM is a potential patient, and you act accordingly.

The content you create is often the first thing a patient sees before d
 to book. When that content is compelling, accurate, and on-brand— people take action. That’s the standard we hold this role to. 



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Day-to-day, here's what this looks like.

• Video Editing

  • Edit short-form video from raw clinic footage for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
.

  • Produce TikTok love letter format content — text-on-screen, B-roll driven — reducing on-camera dependency on clinicians.

  • Deliver completed edits by the morning after raw footage arrives — same-day turnaround is the standard.

  • Cut ad-specific edits separately from organic content — different objectives, different formats.

  • Produce myth/fact series, clinic walkthroughs, and patient education content from provided briefs.

• Organic Social Management

  • Manage the content calendar across TikTok, Instagram, and
 for both Cerebral Health and Magnolia Hyperbarics.

  • Publish a minimum of 5 posts and 3–5 Stories per week on Instagram; minimum 3 posts per week on TikTok.

  • Respond to all comments and DMs within 2 hours during business hours.

  • Identify warm leads in DMs and route them to the right booking flow or front desk contact.

  • Maintain ManyChat automation flows in coordination with the CRM Specialist.

• Content Coordination & Reporting

  • Coordinate with the clinic team to schedule raw footage recording sessions.

  • Track the incoming content pipeline — what's been filmed, edited, scheduled, and published.

  • Ensure all content aligns with brand voice before it goes
 compassionate, confident, expert.

  • Deliver a monthly social post-mortem with performance data and actionable recommendations.

  • Update the weekly scorecard with social metrics: reach, engagement rate, DM leads, follower quality.



YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF...

Two functions. One person. Both at a high level. 

• You live on TikTok and Instagram.

Not as a casual scroller — as someone who studies hooks, watches what performs, and understands why. If you can't tell us what you watched this week, this isn't the role for you.

• You can turn raw footage into a compelling Reel by tomorrow.

Same-day turnaround isn't a stretch goal — it's a baseline. You're fast, organised, and your output is polished under pressure.

• You write captions that sound like a person, not a brand deck.

Warm, direct, and specific. Not "We're proud to offer world-class treatment!" — actual human language that connects.

• You treat a DM like a sales conversation.

You know the difference between a curious follower and someone who's ready to book. You route them correctly and you don't let warm leads go cold.

• You understand what content can't say in healthcare.

You know Meta's ad policies. You know what language flags a post. You don't need to learn this on the job.

• You're strong in both editing and social — not just one.

This is a combined role by design. If you're a great editor who doesn't manage communities — or a great community manager who can't edit — we'll hire those functions separately.



WHAT YOU'LL GET

We take care of the people who take care of our patients.

• Paid Time Off — Recharge so you can perform at your best. We respect the time you take away from work.

• Sick Days — When life happens, it happens. Take the time you need to recover without the pressure.

• Fully Remote — Work remote with a team spread across time zones — autonomy and flexibility built in.

• Real Growth — This is a growing organization. As both brands scale, so do the opportunities for the people building them.

• A Team That Cares — We hire people who are bought into the mission. You'll work alongside others who understand why the work matters, not just what the work is.

• A Greater Mission — Every qualified booking you drive is a patient who gets access to treatment that could change their life. That's not marketing copy — that's the reality of what we do.



Ready to apply?

Send us 3 short-form video samples (under 60 seconds each) and a content calendar or posting schedule you've managed. Show us your editing and your strategy — both matter equally here.

balance sheet accounts

Operational Accounting Support

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (12 MONTHS IN)

on time

? Accounting execution quality remains high even as processes evolve

than when you started



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

? 3 - 7 years of hands-on accounting experience in operational accounting,

bookkeeping, or accounting support functions

? Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online - required

? At least 2 years of general ledger experience, particularly accruals

? Strong accounting fundamentals with high attention to detail and transactional

accuracy

appropriately

tasks



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

environments

payout processes

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

You are likely a strong fit if you:

work

WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

accounting execution

mbers to understand how they work

title: Instagram Reels Video Editor
description:
Who We Are



We're one of the fastest-growing travel jewelry brands in the US, and we want you to become part of our editing team, a global team of talent from all over the world. High pay, real creative ownership, no micromanaging.



Most of our editors have been with us for over a year and a half. This is a long-term partnership, not a gig. Our top editors earn $1,000–$2,000+/month, every month.



Exchange Life sells collectible country flag charms, keychains, bracelets, and necklaces for travelers. We run a fully remote team of editors, filmmakers, and creators across time zones, and we treat our people like long-term partners, not freelancers.



What You'll Do



- Edit short-form content that actually performs. TikTok and Reels. Hook, pacing, captions, B-roll, sound design. Fast cuts built to stop the scroll.

- Think in metrics, not just aesthetics. Hook rate, watch time, and retention are your creative compass. You study what's working and apply it to every edit.

- Collaborate on new concepts with the marketing team. Test new angles, iterate on winning formats, and help shape what the brand looks like at scale.

- Ship fast and stay consistent. No hand-holding needed. You communicate clearly, turn around content quickly, and own your work.



You're a Fit If...

This Isn't for You If...

This is a long-term role. We invest in people who are committed and want to keep getting better. We'll literally pay you to improve: courses, 1-on-1 mentorship, we want you to become the best at what you do and be part of your journey!

title: Manager, Affiliate (Channel) Sales Analyst
description:
Truegenics is a leading eCommerce company with a proven track record of over US$218M in online product sales. Our affiliate program has been a long-standing and critical driver of our success in the U.S. market.



We are hiring a Manager to join our Affiliate Channel Sales team. This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical ability, business acumen, and commercial judgement, who can manage affiliate partnerships and drive measurable revenue growth. 



The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying performance opportunities, improving partner productivity, supporting affiliate recruitment and activation, and translating data into clear business actions that drive revenue, margin, and long-term partner value.



This role works normal office hours, with occasional evening calls to support U.S.-based partners or business needs.



Key Responsibilities



Commercial Analysis & Business Performance

- Own the weekly performance narrative: surface trends, gaps, wins, risks, and clear next steps.

- Analyse affiliate performance across revenue, margin, EPC, AOV, conversion rate, funnel performance, traffic quality, and partner productivity to identify what’s driving or limiting growth.

- Use data & AI to support decisions on partner prioritisation, campaign strategy, offer testing, commission structures, and promotional planning and own the follow-through on those recommendations.

- Identify growth opportunities, underperforming areas, and commercial risks, then recommend clear actions to improve business outcomes.



Affiliate Growth & Partner Activation

- Identify, pitch, and onboard new affiliate partners through
, messaging platforms, calls, and other digital communication channels.

- Ensure new partners are activated quickly, understand campaign requirements, and have the tools needed to start driving results.

- Maintain consistent, structured follow-up with prospective and newly onboarded partners, with a clear pipeline and conversion cadence.



Account Management & Partner Optimization

- Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for a portfolio of affiliate partners, with clear ownership of partner revenue performance.

- Build strong working relationships through responsive communication, structured follow-up, and commercially sound recommendations.

- Resolve partner blockers and help optimize campaigns to improve revenue, margin, conversion performance, and partner engagement.

- Identify high-potential partners and develop plans to scale their contribution.



Campaign Execution & Compliance

- Coordinate launches, bonuses, contests, seasonal promotions, creative updates, funnel tests, and partner-specific offers with internal teams.

- Work closely with Creative, Supply Chain, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure campaigns are executed on time and aligned with business goals.

- Monitor partner activity, promotional methods, messaging, and traffic quality to ensure compliance with affiliate guidelines, terms and conditions, and brand standards.

- Escalate suspicious activity, compliance risks, or poor-quality traffic when needed.



Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process Improvement

- Share market, competitor, and partner feedback with internal teams to improve offers, messaging, creative assets, funnels, and partner tools.

- Contribute to process improvements, including the use of AI and automation, to make the affiliate program more scalable, efficient, and commercially effective.





Key Skills & Experience

- 5 to 8 years of experience in sales, affiliate marketing, channel sales, partnerships, digital marketing, or eCommerce growth, with at least 2 to 3 years of experience managing affiliate, channel partner, partnership, or performance-based sales programs.

- Background in personal care, health, wellness, supplements, pharmaceutical, or direct-response eCommerce industries is a plus.

- Strong analytical skills and business acumen, with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into practical business actions.

- Clear understanding of revenue, margin, conversion, AOV, EPC, ROI, and commercial trade-offs.

- Proven track record of driving revenue growth through affiliates, partners, online sales channels, or performance marketing initiatives.

- Solid understanding of online sales, digital marketing funnels, affiliate networks, partner marketing, or performance-based acquisition.

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups, trend analysis, and performance reporting.

- Comfortable using AI tools and automation to improve business analysis, reporting, partner management, campaign execution, or operational efficiency. Candidates should be able to share practical use cases. Willingness to use AI and automation is a requirement for this role.

- Comfortable communicating with prospects and partners through
, messaging platforms, and occasional calls, with strong written communication skills for outreach, follow-ups, campaign updates, and commercial recommendations. 

- Able to manage multiple partners, campaigns, and priorities independently.



Other Notes:

The candidate should be comfortable working with U.S.-based partners and joining occasional evening calls as and when needed, estimated at least once per month. There may also be occasional travel to the U.S. or other locations for networking conferences or business needs, approximately 2–3 times per year, if required. 



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is commercially sharp, analytical, and proactive. The right candidate should be able to look at affiliate performance, understand what is driving or limiting growth, and recommend practical actions that improve results.



This person does not need to be primarily a face-to-face salesperson. However, they should be comfortable engaging prospects and partners through written communication, messaging,
, and occasional calls.



The ideal candidate is someone who can balance numbers, partner relationships, execution, and business judgment.



Working Arrangement:

- Laptop / CPU with acceptable speed

title: Highly Organized Personal Executive Assistant for Multi-Venture Business Owner
description:
1. Overview & Company Philosophy

We are seeking an exceptionally organized, systematic, and detail-oriented Executive Virtual Assistant to act as a direct personal anchor and operational filter for a multi-venture business owner. 



Please note: You will assist the owner personally in managing their executive responsibilities across two separate companies. You will work directly for the owner, rather than working for or being embedded within either of the corporate entities themselves.



This role is designed to act as a defensive shield between the owner and daily operational chaos, allowing them to shift from a reactive mindset into high-level business execution. If you take extreme pride in system order and structural consistency, we want you to be our partner in building that order. 



2. Core Responsibilities

You will manage three tightly systemized personal workflows for the owner on a daily basis:

a. Weekly Preparation & Cross-Inbox Management: Act as the primary gatekeeper and filter for the owner’s separate corporate mailboxes. Clear out operational noise, flag messages requiring immediate attention, and archive/log administrative items. Curate and prepare the owner's personal master schedule every Friday afternoon, creating a blueprint block map for the upcoming week.

b. Personal Briefing & Meeting Coordination: Coordinate recurring meetings and streamline multi-calendar scheduling native to Outlook. Prior to any major executive engagement, build an organized "Meeting Brief" card inside our personal work hub 24 hours in advance, compiling context, historic files, and priority agendas so the owner is instantly briefed. 

c. Asynchronous Progress Tracking & Project Hub Auditing: Audit and centralize the owner's personal tracking visibility across multiple venture boards using OpenProject. Act as a direct buffer for the owner by monitoring milestone dates, checking boards for data entry holes, and cleanly requesting real-time updates from other tea
mbers inside the platform. Submit a structured Daily Report at the end of every shift answering three questions: 1. What was completed today? 2. What blocks or questions require the owner's feedback? 3. What are the definitive priorities for next shift?



3. Required Profile & Skills

Ideal Personality Profile: You must love building order and following systematic rules.

Technical Literacy: Advanced experience with Microsoft Outlook (specifically multi-account structures, folder logic). Highly comfortable with or capable of instantly navigating project management infrastructure like OpenProject, Asana, or Basecamp.

Communication: Exceptional written English and clear, text-based asynchronous communication. You must be comfortable tracking down task details independently.



4. Expectations & Work Culture

Engagement Type: Part-time (3 hours per week). 

Culture Fit: Guided by classical principles of stewardship, progress, and systematic order. We value careful execution and clear ownership over your work. Mistakes are never fixed *for* you; instead, the owner will point out errors so you can systematically correct them yourself to master the process.



5. How to Apply (Please Read Carefully)

We are looking for someone who pays extreme attention to detail and can follow systematic rules. To ensure that you have read this entire job post and understand the role, you must use the exact phrase "I love building systematic order" as the subject line of your application.



In your message, please include a brief 2-3 sentence introduction detailing your experience with Outlook Delegate Access and Project Management tools. Applications that do not follow these exact instructions will be automatically ignored.

title: Fractional Growth / GTM Lead
description:
The Company



Hire Anywhere connects UK small businesses with vetted, full-time overseas talent through a proper headhunting model — not a gig marketplace. We give founders the Fortune 500 international hiring playbook, run for them by a Head of Talent in Manila who has built teams for global organisations.



We're a small founder-led business and ready to build the demand side properly.



The Problem We're Hiring You to Fix



We have no demand engine. Nobody is doing outbound. The product works and the supply side is solid — there is simply no pipeline, because there has never been anyone whose job is to build one.



This role is not about managing isolated marketing channels. It’s about helping us build a repeatable pipeline and creating qualified conversations with founders who are exploring overseas hiring for the first time.



A large part of the challenge is trust and positioning. Business owners are often interested in overseas hiring, but uncertain whether the quality, communication, and cultural fit will actually work in practice.



That’s the role.



What You'll Own



You own the demand engine end to end:



- Building the target account list against our ICP

- Setting up the outbound infrastructure — sending tooling, LinkedIn presence, simple landing pages, booking flow

- Writing and running multi-channel outbound sequences 
-led, LinkedIn alongside, selective calling)

- Managing inbound replies and getting qualified discovery calls into the founder's calendar

- Refining messaging and positioning based on market feedback and response data

- Reporting pipeline and outreach metrics weekly



The founder owns the ICP definition, discovery calls, recruitment delivery, and pricing — and review messaging before it goes out. Everything else on the demand side is yours.



Who We're Looking For

- You have personally built B2B outbound or pipeline generation from zero — not managed a team that did, built it yourself

- Experience with a high-ticket, considered-purchase service sold via conversations (recruitment, staffing, professional services, agencies, or high-touch B2B SaaS are closest)

- You think commercially and strategically, but operate hands-on

- You’re comfortable owning the full demand generation process rather than specialising in a single channel

- Genuinely hands-on: you'll build the list, write the sequences, set up the tooling and send the outreach yourself

- Self-directing: you take “here’s the ICP and the narrative, go” and come back with a built system and live outreach

- Comfortable owning numbers and being held accountable to pipeline outcomes



Probably not a fit:

- pure paid-media backgrounds

- pure SEO/content backgrounds

- social-media-only marketers

- strategists or advisors who direct rather than execute

- anyone who needs a team or large budget to function

- Target customer (so you can picture the work)



Small, founder-led UK businesses — solo up to ~30 people — in media, marketing/creative agencies, business advisory, or e-commerce.



The founder is the buyer and the budget. They're buried in delegatable work while growth stalls, and they've usually either been burned by a talent marketplace or never knew real overseas hiring was an option for a business their size.



Work Set Up

- Rolling monthly contract, roughly 2–3 days per week, UK hours

- Clear 60–90 day expectation: target list built, outbound infrastructure live, and a consistent flow of qualified discovery calls being booked

- Reports directly to the founders; weekly pipeline review

title: Backend & Automation Developer (Part-Time: 5–10 Hours/Week) — T-SQL, Python, & N8N
description:
ABOUT US



We are a growing business ecosystem guided by classical operational principles of stewardship, order, and progress. We pride ourselves on hands-on prototyping. We quickly build functional, "vibe-coded" mockups and workflows that prove a business concept works.



Now, we are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Online Filipino Specialist (OFS) to serve as our Backend & Automation Developer. Your primary mission will be to step in behind our prototype logic, refactor it, clean it up, and make it bulletproof, performant, and production-ready.



ROLE OVERVIEW & RESPONSIBILITIES



This is a flexible, highly focused part-time position requiring 5 to 10 hours per week. You will be working directly with the business owner asynchronously.



Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:



T-SQL Refactoring & Optimization: Reviewing draft SQL queries built for dashboards, rewriting inefficient joins, implementing proper indexing, and formatting code to ensure peak database performance.



Python Script Optimization: Reviewing, modularizing, and optimizing existing Python scripts. This includes adding structured logging, implementing clean error-handling blocks, and managing API payloads.



N8N Workflow Orchestration: Building and organizing workflows within N8N to automate backend tasks. You will manage and refactor API calls, handle webhooks, and map data across platforms.



Asynchronous Collaboration: Reviewing video walkthroughs (such as Loom screen recordings) detailing project specifications, asking clarifying questions, and independently delivering optimized code.



REQUIRED SKILLS & TECHNICAL STACK



Database Management: Strong proficiency in T-SQL / MS SQL Server. You must understand query optimization, indexing, explicit joins, and database security best practices.



Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python for backend scripting, data manipulation, and working with REST APIs (using libraries such as requests, json, pandas, etc.).



Automation Workflow Tools: Direct, practical experience utilizing N8N (or closely related node-based automation platforms like Make or Zapier) to build and troubleshoot API integrations.



Quality Assurance Mindset: Strong code optimization skills. You should naturally write self-documenting code with clear variable naming, modular structures, and comprehensive error handling.



Communication: Exceptional written English. Because this role is asynchronous, you must be comfortable tracking down task details independently and articulating technical concepts clearly via text or video.



WORK SCHEDULE, EXPECTATIONS, & CULTURE



Weekly Hours: 5 to 10 hours per week.



Flexible Schedule: You can work your own hours during the day or night. We value output and code quality over the exact time on the clock.



No Micromanagement: We do not use invasive, screenshot-taking time-trackers. Instead, we gauge your value based on the elegance, readability, and reliability of your code.



Daily Reports: To keep tasks moving smoothly, we require a quick, simple end-of-day
 report answering three questions (even if you worked 0 hours that day):

What did you work on/complete today?

What roadblocks or issues did you encounter?

What are your next steps?



Culture of Ownership: We encourage an environment of high accountability and low fear. We expect you to speak up if our prototype logic is flawed. Your job is to point out mistakes, suggest better architectural patterns, and systematically take ownership of the code quality.



COMPENSATION & TRUST-BUILDING TERMS



Hourly Rate: Competitive hourly rate based on technical experience and depth of skills. Let us know your expected hourly rate in your application.



Weekly Payments: To build mutual trust and assure you that we are a legitimate, reliable partner, we will establish weekly payments for your first two months of employment, transitioning to bi-weekly or monthly payments afterward based on your preference.



Growth Opportunity: While this role begins at 5–10 hours per week, there is a clear opportunity for your hours and responsibilities to scale as our systems grow and your integration with our workflows deepens.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)
